blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 ATMP（先進療法藥品）原物料為何面臨比傳統藥品更複雜的品質管理挑戰，包含來源多樣性、法規不一致及供應商成熟度問題。
blocks.en: Understand why raw materials for ATMPs (advanced therapy medicinal products) pose more complex quality management challenges than those for conventional drugs, including diverse sourcing, inconsistent regulations and variable supplier maturity.

blocks.zh: 掌握本文件的適用範圍：涵蓋臨床與商業製造中所有與製程流接觸之原物料，包含細胞治療、基因治療、mRNA 及組織工程產品。
blocks.en: Grasp the scope of this document: all materials that contact the process stream in clinical and commercial manufacturing, including cell therapy, gene therapy, mRNA and tissue-engineered products.

blocks.zh: 區分初級（Primary）、次級（Secondary）、三級（Tertiary）動物源性與人源性物料的定義，並能在實際採購及風險評估中正確應用。
blocks.en: Distinguish the definitions of primary, secondary and tertiary animal-derived and human-derived materials, and apply them correctly in real-world sourcing and risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 熟悉本文件使用的核心縮寫（AAV、CAR、RUO、TSE、iPSC 等），作為閱讀後續章節的語言基礎。
blocks.en: Become familiar with the core abbreviations used in this document (AAV, CAR, RUO, TSE, iPSC, etc.) as the language foundation for the sections that follow.

blocks.en: Introduction

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 為何 ATMP 物料管理如此複雜？
blocks.en: Core Concept: Why Is Materials Management So Complex for ATMPs?

blocks.zh: Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products（先進療法藥品，ATMP）涵蓋四大類：
blocks.en: Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products (ATMPs) fall into four categories:

blocks.zh: 基因治療產品（Gene Therapy）：如 AAV 載體基因治療、mRNA 療法
blocks.en: Gene therapy products: for example, AAV vector gene therapies and mRNA therapies

blocks.zh: 體細胞治療產品（Somatic Cell Therapy）：如 CAR-T、TIL 療法
blocks.en: Somatic cell therapy products: for example, CAR-T and TIL therapies

blocks.zh: 組織工程產品（Tissue Engineered Products）：如人工皮膚、軟骨修復
blocks.en: Tissue-engineered products: for example, artificial skin and cartilage repair

blocks.zh: 複合式 ATMP（Combined ATMP）：結合醫材與細胞/基因治療
blocks.en: Combined ATMPs: medical devices combined with cell or gene therapy

blocks.zh: 相較於傳統小分子藥或生物製劑，ATMP 的原物料往往直接來自生物體（人或動物），缺乏藥典專論（monograph）作為品質標準錨點，且大量物料僅有研究等級（RUO）規格，這使得品質保證的起點就已相當困難。
blocks.en: Compared with small-molecule drugs or conventional biologics, ATMP raw materials often come directly from living organisms (human or animal), lack pharmacopoeial monographs as an anchor for quality standards, and are in many cases available only to research use only (RUO) specifications. As a result, quality assurance is already difficult at the starting point.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — CDMO 採購視角的比喻
blocks.en: Analogy: A CDMO Sourcing Perspective

blocks.zh: 想像您在替一家米其林三星餐廳採購食材：傳統藥廠就像採購有產地認證、農殘標準的超市蔬菜；但 ATMP 的物料採購，更像是向山區農夫個人直接訂購稀有野菇——供應商可能只是一位退休教授在自家實驗室培養，沒有 ISO 認證，沒有 GMP 廠房，但您的患者卻完全依賴這瓶培養基的品質。
blocks.en: Imagine you are buying ingredients for a three-star Michelin restaurant. A conventional pharmaceutical plant is like buying supermarket vegetables with certified origin and pesticide residue standards. Sourcing materials for ATMPs is more like ordering rare wild mushrooms directly from an individual mountain farmer: the supplier may be a retired professor growing the product in a home laboratory, with no ISO certification and no GMP facility, yet your patients depend entirely on the quality of that bottle of culture medium.

blocks.zh: 這就是 PtC-13 存在的根本原因：替 CDMO 和 MAH 提供一套系統性的思考框架，在不得不使用「農夫直送野菇」的情況下，仍能確保患者安全。
blocks.en: This is the fundamental reason PtC-13 exists: to give CDMOs and MAHs a systematic framework for thinking, so that patient safety can still be assured when the "farm-direct wild mushrooms" cannot be avoided.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 法規不一致的實務衝擊
blocks.en: Key Point: The Practical Impact of Regulatory Inconsistency

blocks.zh: 目前，ATMP 物料的法規要求在四大監管體系間存在顯著差異：
blocks.en: Today, regulatory requirements for ATMP materials differ significantly across four regulatory systems:

blocks.zh: FDA（美國）：主要依 21 CFR Part 210/211 及 Part 1271，以 IND/BLA 申請為核心管控架構
blocks.en: FDA (United States): relies mainly on 21 CFR Parts 210/211 and Part 1271, with the IND/BLA application as the core control framework

blocks.zh: EMA（歐盟）：ATMP 受 Regulation (EC) No 1394/2007 規範，有專屬的 ATMP 委員會（CAT）
blocks.en: EMA (European Union): ATMPs are governed by Regulation (EC) No 1394/2007, with a dedicated Committee for Advanced Therapies (CAT)

blocks.zh: PMDA（日本）：JSBRM（生物原料標準）為日本特有要求，對動物源性物料的文件要求極為嚴格
blocks.en: PMDA (Japan): the JSBRM (Japanese Standards for Biological Raw Materials) is a uniquely Japanese requirement, with extremely strict documentation requirements for animal-derived materials

blocks.zh: PIC/S：提供 GMP 指南，但成員國仍有各自詮釋空間
blocks.en: PIC/S: provides GMP guidance, but member authorities still have room for their own interpretation

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，若同時服務 FDA、EMA、PMDA 監管下的客戶，需要為同一批物料維護多套合規文件——這是 PtC-13 對策略性物料管理強調的核心原因之一。
blocks.en: A CDMO serving clients under FDA, EMA and PMDA oversight at the same time has to maintain several sets of compliance documents for the same batch of material. This is one of the core reasons PtC-13 stresses strategic materials management.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一個 CDMO 正在為 CAR-T 細胞治療產品採購 IL-2（介白素-2），供應商只提供 RUO 等級規格。請問這在 GMP 製造中會引發哪些合規風險？您會採取哪些措施來降低風險？
blocks.en: A CDMO is sourcing IL-2 (interleukin-2) for a CAR-T cell therapy product, and the supplier offers only RUO-grade specifications. What compliance risks does this create in GMP manufacturing, and what measures would you take to reduce them?

blocks.zh: 為什麼「單一供應商（single-sourced）」的物料對 ATMP 製造特別危險？請從品質風險管理（QRM）的角度分析，並列出至少兩項緩解策略。
blocks.en: Why is a single-sourced material particularly dangerous in ATMP manufacturing? Analyze this from a quality risk management (QRM) perspective and list at least two mitigation strategies.

blocks.zh: PtC-13 提到法規未全球統一。若您的 ATMP 產品需同時在美國（FDA）和歐盟（EMA）申請上市，物料管理策略上應提前準備哪些差異性文件？
blocks.en: PtC-13 notes that regulations are not harmonized globally. If your ATMP product needs to be filed for marketing in both the US (FDA) and the EU (EMA), which region-specific documents should your materials management strategy prepare in advance?

blocks.zh: 適用範圍 Scope
blocks.en: Scope

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 「與製程流接觸」的物料範疇
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Scope of "Process-Stream-Contacting" Materials

blocks.zh: Process-stream-contacting raw materials（與製程流接觸之原物料）是 PtC-13 的管控核心。這個概念涵蓋任何在製程中可能與產品直接接觸、或透過間接方式影響產品品質的物料，包括：
blocks.en: Process-stream-contacting raw materials are the control focus of PtC-13. The concept covers any material that may contact the product directly during the process, or affect product quality indirectly, including:

blocks.zh: 起始物料（Starting materials）：如患者或捐贈者的細胞、病毒種子株
blocks.en: Starting materials: for example, patient or donor cells and virus seed stocks

blocks.zh: 輔助物料（Ancillary materials）：如培養基成分、生長因子、轉導試劑
blocks.en: Ancillary materials: for example, culture medium components, growth factors and transduction reagents

blocks.zh: 賦形劑（Excipients）：製劑配方成分
blocks.en: Excipients: components of the formulation

blocks.zh: 消耗品（Consumables）：如過濾器、一次性袋、管路
blocks.en: Consumables: for example, filters, single-use bags and tubing

blocks.zh: 容器密封系統（Container-closure systems）：最終儲存容器
blocks.en: Container-closure systems: the final storage container

blocks.zh: 請注意：不與製程流直接接觸的設備（如廠房結構、HVAC）不在本文件主要討論範圍內。
blocks.en: Note that equipment that does not directly contact the process stream (such as building structure and HVAC) is outside the main scope of this document.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — ATMP 產品類型的光譜
blocks.en: Analogy: The Spectrum of ATMP Product Types

blocks.zh: PtC-13 的範圍涵蓋了 ATMP 的完整產品光譜，從製造複雜度由低到高可排列為：
blocks.en: The scope of PtC-13 covers the full spectrum of ATMP products. In order of increasing manufacturing complexity, they can be arranged as follows:

blocks.zh: mRNA 療法（如 mRNA 疫苗類型）→ AAV 病毒載體基因治療→ 異體細胞治療（allogeneic cell therapy）→ 自體細胞治療（autologous cell therapy，如 CAR-T）
blocks.en: mRNA therapies (such as mRNA vaccine types) → AAV viral vector gene therapies → allogeneic cell therapies → autologous cell therapies (such as CAR-T)

blocks.zh: 越往右，製程中用到的生物源性物料越多、製程複雜度越高，物料管理挑戰也越大。理解自己的產品位於這個光譜的哪個位置，直接決定物料風險評估的深度。
blocks.en: The further to the right, the more biologically derived materials are used in the process, the more complex the process, and the greater the materials management challenge. Understanding where your product sits on this spectrum directly determines the depth of your materials risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 臨床與商業製造的物料策略差異
blocks.en: Key Point: Differences in Materials Strategy Between Clinical and Commercial Manufacturing

blocks.zh: PtC-13 明確涵蓋臨床期（clinical stage）與商業製造（commercial manufacture）兩個階段，但實務上兩者的物料策略有所不同：
blocks.en: PtC-13 explicitly covers both the clinical stage and commercial manufacture, but in practice the materials strategies differ between the two:

blocks.zh: 臨床期：接受較高風險的 RUO 物料，但必須有風險評估文件支撐；供應商審計可採用問卷代替現場稽核
blocks.en: Clinical stage: higher-risk RUO materials are accepted, but they must be supported by a documented risk assessment; supplier audits may use questionnaires in place of on-site audits

blocks.zh: 商業製造：須完成完整的供應商資格確認（Vendor Qualification），物料規格需與法規申請文件鎖定
blocks.en: Commercial manufacture: full vendor qualification must be completed, and material specifications must be locked in with the regulatory filing documents

blocks.zh: 這種「相對應的 phase-appropriate 方法」是 ATMP 物料管理的核心哲學，在 PtC-13 後續章節中會反覆出現。
blocks.en: This phase-appropriate approach is the core philosophy of ATMP materials management and recurs throughout the later sections of PtC-13.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 物料範疇盤點
blocks.en: Practical Application: Inventorying the CDMO Materials Scope

blocks.zh: 作為一個正在承接 AAV 基因治療 CDMO 合約的品保主管，您在啟動物料管理計畫時，應按以下層次盤點製程物料：
blocks.en: As a QA head taking on an AAV gene therapy CDMO contract, you should inventory process materials in the following tiers when launching a materials management program:

blocks.zh: 第一層：起始物料 — 質體 DNA（plasmid DNA）、細胞種子庫（如 HEK293 細胞）是否有 GMP 級別的 CoA 和 CoO？
blocks.en: Tier 1: Starting materials - Do plasmid DNA and cell seed banks (such as HEK293 cells) have GMP-grade CoAs and CoOs?

blocks.zh: 第二層：培養製程輔助物料 — 無血清培養基的動物源性成分分析（Animal-Derived Component Free, ADCF 聲明）是否完整？
blocks.en: Tier 2: Ancillary materials for the culture process - Is the analysis of animal-derived components in the serum-free medium (Animal-Derived Component Free, ADCF statement) complete?

blocks.zh: 第三層：下游純化耗材 — 親和層析管柱填料是否含動物源蛋白質（如配基蛋白 Protein A/G）？
blocks.en: Tier 3: Downstream purification consumables - Does the affinity chromatography resin contain animal-derived proteins (such as the Protein A/G ligand)?

blocks.zh: 第四層：製劑賦形劑與容器密封 — 是否使用 USP/EP 藥典等級物料？容器材質相容性測試文件是否齊全？
blocks.en: Tier 4: Formulation excipients and container closure - Are USP/EP pharmacopoeial-grade materials used? Is the container material compatibility testing documentation complete?

blocks.zh: 詞彙表 Glossary
blocks.en: Glossary

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — Primary / Secondary / Tertiary 三層分類系統
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Primary / Secondary / Tertiary Classification System

blocks.zh: PtC-13 對動物源性和人源性物料建立了一套「三層污染追蹤分類系統」，這是本文件最重要的概念架構之一。理解三者的差異是後續風險評估的基礎：
blocks.en: PtC-13 establishes a "three-tier contamination traceability classification system" for animal-derived and human-derived materials, one of the most important conceptual frameworks in this document. Understanding the differences among the three tiers is the basis for the risk assessments that follow:

blocks.zh:
初級（Primary）物料：直接來自動物或人體的物料。
動物源例子：牛血清白蛋白（BSA）、豬胰島素、牛胎血清（FBS）
人源例子：人血漿白蛋白、人血小板溶解物（hPL）、患者 PBMC
blocks.en:
Primary materials: materials taken directly from animals or the human body.
Animal-derived examples: bovine serum albumin (BSA), porcine insulin, fetal bovine serum (FBS)
Human-derived examples: human plasma albumin, human platelet lysate (hPL), patient PBMC

blocks.zh:
次級（Secondary）物料：製造過程中使用了動物/人源物料，但最終產品本身不一定含有動物/人源成分。
例子：用含 BSA 的培養基生產的重組蛋白；用含動物成分的培養基生產的酵素
blocks.en:
Secondary materials: animal- or human-derived materials were used in the manufacturing process, but the final product itself does not necessarily contain animal- or human-derived components.
Examples: a recombinant protein produced in BSA-containing medium; an enzyme produced in medium containing animal components

blocks.zh:
三級（Tertiary）物料：最終產品本身不含動物/人源成分，但其製造過程使用了次級物料。
例子：用含動物源酵素催化合成的化學原料；用次級物料生產的無動物源試劑
blocks.en:
Tertiary materials: the final product itself contains no animal- or human-derived components, but its manufacturing process used secondary materials.
Examples: a chemical raw material synthesized with the aid of an animal-derived enzyme; an animal-free reagent produced using secondary materials

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 咖啡的「產地溯源」比喻
blocks.en: Analogy: The Coffee "Origin Traceability" Analogy

blocks.zh: 用咖啡供應鏈來類比三層分類系統：
blocks.en: Consider the coffee supply chain as an analogy for the three-tier classification system:

blocks.zh: 初級物料 = 咖啡豆本身（直接來自植物）。如果把「動物」換成「植物」，生咖啡豆就是直接來源。
blocks.en: Primary material = the coffee bean itself (taken directly from the plant). If you replace "animal" with "plant", green coffee beans are the direct source.

blocks.zh: 次級物料 = 用動物奶沖泡的拿鐵咖啡液（製程中使用了動物源性原料）。最終液體包含奶的成分。
blocks.en: Secondary material = a latte brewed with animal milk (animal-derived raw material used in the process). The final liquid contains milk components.

blocks.zh: 三級物料 = 用拿鐵製成的咖啡糖果（最終產品加工後可能不含奶，但製程確實用過含奶的中間物）。
blocks.en: Tertiary material = coffee candy made from the latte (after processing, the final product may no longer contain milk, but the process did use a milk-containing intermediate).

blocks.zh: 在 ATMP 製造中，三級物料雖然「看起來乾淨」，但仍需要記錄其製程溯源，以評估潛在的 TSE/BSE 風險或病毒污染風險。這就是供應商必須提供完整 CoO 的原因。
blocks.en: In ATMP manufacturing, a tertiary material may "look clean", but its process traceability must still be documented to assess the potential TSE/BSE or viral contamination risk. This is why suppliers must provide a complete CoO.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — CJD 與 TSE/BSE 的監管意義
blocks.en: Key Point: The Regulatory Significance of CJD and TSE/BSE

blocks.zh: 克雅氏病（Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease, CJD）屬於傳染性海綿狀腦病（TSE, Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathies）家族，與牛腦海綿狀病（BSE，俗稱「狂牛症」）同屬 prion disease（普里昂疾病）。
blocks.en: Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease (CJD) belongs to the family of Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathies (TSE) and, like bovine spongiform encephalopathy (BSE, commonly called "mad cow disease"), is a prion disease.

blocks.zh: 為何 PtC-13 在詞彙表第一條就定義 CJD？因為動物源性物料（尤其是牛源性物料如 FBS）是 TSE/BSE 的主要潛在污染路徑。監管機構對牛源性物料有嚴格的地理來源要求——
blocks.en: Why does PtC-13 define CJD as the first entry in the glossary? Because animal-derived materials (especially bovine-derived materials such as FBS) are the main potential route of TSE/BSE contamination. Regulators impose strict geographic-origin requirements on bovine-derived materials:

blocks.zh: FDA：依 BSE 風險分類，來自高風險國家的牛源物料需額外文件證明
blocks.en: FDA: based on BSE risk categories, bovine-derived materials from high-risk countries require additional supporting documentation

blocks.zh: PMDA / JSBRM：對生物原料的動物源及地理來源有最為嚴格的規定
blocks.en: PMDA / JSBRM: the strictest requirements on the animal origin and geographic origin of biological raw materials

blocks.zh: 因此，若您的 ATMP 製程中用到任何牛源物料，必須取得該物料的 CoO（Certificate of Origin）並評估 TSE 風險，這不只是 GMP 要求，也是各國市場准入的必要條件。
blocks.en: Therefore, if any bovine-derived material is used in your ATMP process, you must obtain the CoO (Certificate of Origin) for that material and assess the TSE risk. This is not only a GMP requirement but also a prerequisite for market access in many countries.

blocks.zh: 分類框架 — 三層物料風險分類決策樹
blocks.en: Classification Framework: Decision Tree for the Three-Tier Material Risk Classification

blocks.zh:
物料X 是否直接來自動物或人體組織/體液？
├─ 是 → 【初級物料 Primary】
│        風險最高，需完整 CoA + CoO + TSE 風險評估
│
└─ 否 → 其製造過程是否使用動物/人源物料？
         ├─ 是 → 【次級物料 Secondary】
         │        需供應商聲明 + 製程物料清單（BOM）
         │        確認動物源成分種類與地理來源
         │
         └─ 否（但供應商的供應商可能用過）→
                  【三級物料 Tertiary】或【非動物源】
                  需供應商提供「Animal-Derived Component
                  Free (ADCF)」書面聲明方可接受
blocks.en:
Is material X taken directly from animal or human tissue/body fluid?
├─ Yes → [Primary material]
│        Highest risk; requires full CoA + CoO + TSE risk assessment
│
└─ No → Does its manufacturing process use animal/human-derived materials?
         ├─ Yes → [Secondary material]
         │        Requires supplier statement + process materials list (BOM)
         │        Confirm type and geographic origin of animal-derived components
         │
         └─ No (but the supplier's supplier may have used them) →
                  [Tertiary material] or [non-animal-derived]
                  Acceptable only with a written "Animal-Derived Component
                  Free (ADCF)" statement from the supplier

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 物料分類實戰演練
blocks.en: Practical Application: Material Classification Exercise

blocks.zh: 請將以下 ATMP 製造常見物料分類為初級／次級／三級動物源性物料，並說明理由：
blocks.en: Classify the following materials commonly used in ATMP manufacturing as primary, secondary or tertiary animal-derived materials, and explain your reasoning:

blocks.zh: 牛胎血清（Fetal Bovine Serum, FBS）：由牛胎兒血液直接分離 → 初級動物源性物料
blocks.en: Fetal Bovine Serum (FBS): isolated directly from the blood of bovine fetuses → primary animal-derived material

blocks.zh: 無血清培養基（Serum-Free Medium, SFM）：配方中不含血清，但某成分（如重組白蛋白）係用含 FBS 培養基的宿主細胞生產 → 次級動物源性物料
blocks.en: Serum-Free Medium (SFM): the formulation contains no serum, but one component (such as recombinant albumin) is produced by host cells grown in FBS-containing medium → secondary animal-derived material

blocks.zh: 化學合成的 DMSO（二甲基亞碸）：全化學合成，供應商以書面聲明製程不使用任何動物源物料 → 非動物源物料（需保存聲明文件）
blocks.en: Chemically synthesized DMSO (dimethyl sulfoxide): fully chemically synthesized, with a written supplier statement that no animal-derived material is used in the process → non-animal-derived material (the statement must be retained)

blocks.zh: 重組蛋白 A 親和層析填料：蛋白 A 係大腸桿菌重組表達，但培養基可能含有動物源水解物 → 需調查確認，可能為次級或三級
blocks.en: Recombinant Protein A affinity chromatography resin: Protein A is expressed recombinantly in E. coli, but the culture medium may contain animal-derived hydrolysates → requires investigation to confirm; may be secondary or tertiary

blocks.zh: 為什麼三級動物源性物料雖然「最終產品不含動物源成分」，在 ATMP 製造中仍需要記錄其製程溯源？請從 TSE 風險管理和法規遵從的角度說明。
blocks.en: Why does a tertiary animal-derived material, even though "the final product contains no animal-derived components", still need its process traceability documented in ATMP manufacturing? Explain from the perspective of TSE risk management and regulatory compliance.

blocks.zh: 人源性物料（Human-Derived Materials）的分類邏輯與動物源性相同。請列舉一個初級人源性物料、一個次級人源性物料的例子，並說明各自的主要安全風險（提示：病毒安全性、傳染病）。
blocks.en: The classification logic for human-derived materials is the same as for animal-derived materials. Give one example of a primary human-derived material and one of a secondary human-derived material, and describe the main safety risk of each (hint: viral safety, communicable disease).

blocks.zh: 如果您的 ATMP 供應商聲稱其重組酵素為「ADCF（Animal-Derived Component Free）」，作為採購方您應要求哪些文件來驗證此聲明？
blocks.en: If your ATMP supplier claims that its recombinant enzyme is "ADCF (Animal-Derived Component Free)", what documents should you, as the purchaser, require to verify this claim?

blocks.zh: 縮寫表 Abbreviations
blocks.en: Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — ATMP 產品類型縮寫解析
blocks.en: Core Concept: Understanding ATMP Product-Type Abbreviations

blocks.zh: PtC-13 的縮寫表揭示了 ATMP 治療領域的主要技術方向。以下按治療模態分組：
blocks.en: The abbreviation list in PtC-13 reveals the main technology directions in the ATMP field. They are grouped below by therapeutic modality:

blocks.zh: 基因治療載體：
blocks.en: Gene therapy vectors:

blocks.zh: AAV（腺相關病毒）：目前最主流的體內（in-vivo）基因治療載體，如治療血友病的 Hemgenix、脊髓性肌萎縮症的 Zolgensma
blocks.en: AAV (adeno-associated virus): currently the most widely used in vivo gene therapy vector, as in Hemgenix for hemophilia and Zolgensma for spinal muscular atrophy

blocks.zh: gRNA（導引 RNA）：CRISPR 基因編輯的核心組件，gRNA 引導 Cas9 蛋白切割特定 DNA 位點
blocks.en: gRNA (guide RNA): a core component of CRISPR gene editing; the gRNA guides the Cas9 protein to cut at a specific DNA site

blocks.zh: 細胞治療起始物料：
blocks.en: Cell therapy starting materials:

blocks.zh: PBMC（周邊血單核細胞）：採集自患者或捐贈者血液，是 CAR-T 和 TIL 治療的細胞起始物料
blocks.en: PBMC (peripheral blood mononuclear cells): collected from the blood of patients or donors; the cell starting material for CAR-T and TIL therapies

blocks.zh: TIL（腫瘤浸潤淋巴細胞）：從腫瘤組織中分離的免疫細胞，用於實體瘤細胞治療（如黑色素瘤）
blocks.en: TIL (tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes): immune cells isolated from tumor tissue and used in cell therapy for solid tumors (such as melanoma)

blocks.zh: 幹細胞來源：
blocks.en: Stem cell sources:

blocks.zh: hESC（人類胚胎幹細胞）：多能幹細胞，倫理爭議較大，使用受嚴格監管
blocks.en: hESC (human embryonic stem cells): pluripotent stem cells; ethically controversial, and their use is tightly regulated

blocks.zh: iPSC（誘導多能幹細胞）：由成體細胞重編程而來，是下一代異體細胞治療的關鍵平台技術
blocks.en: iPSC (induced pluripotent stem cells): reprogrammed from adult cells; a key platform technology for next-generation allogeneic cell therapy

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 法規與品質文件縮寫
blocks.en: Core Concept: Regulatory and Quality Document Abbreviations

blocks.zh: CoA vs. CoO — 兩張最關鍵的物料文件：
blocks.en: CoA vs. CoO: the two most critical material documents:

blocks.zh: CoA（Certificate of Analysis，分析合格證書）：記錄物料的實測品質數據（如純度、效價、外觀），是物料放行的品質依據
blocks.en: CoA (Certificate of Analysis): records the measured quality data of a material (such as purity, potency and appearance) and is the quality basis for material release

blocks.zh: CoO（Certificate of Origin，原產地證書）：記錄物料的動物/人源組分地理來源，是 TSE/BSE 風險評估和海關申報的法規依據
blocks.en: CoO (Certificate of Origin): records the geographic origin of the animal- or human-derived components of a material; it is the regulatory basis for TSE/BSE risk assessment and customs declaration

blocks.zh: ATMP 製造中，CoO 的重要性不亞於 CoA——一批沒有 CoO 的動物源性培養基，即使品質數據完美，在某些監管轄區也可能無法用於 GMP 製造。
blocks.en: In ATMP manufacturing, the CoO is just as important as the CoA. A batch of animal-derived medium without a CoO may be unusable for GMP manufacturing in some jurisdictions, even if its quality data are perfect.

blocks.zh: IND（Investigational New Drug）：美國 FDA 的臨床試驗申請，物料合規要求相對寬鬆（phase-appropriate）
blocks.en: IND (Investigational New Drug): the US FDA application for clinical trials; material compliance requirements are relatively lenient (phase-appropriate)

blocks.zh: BLA（Biologics License Application）：美國 FDA 的生物製品上市申請，物料需完成完整資格確認
blocks.en: BLA (Biologics License Application): the US FDA marketing application for biological products; materials must complete full qualification

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — JSBRM 是什麼？為何重要？
blocks.en: Key Point: What Is JSBRM and Why Does It Matter?

blocks.zh: JSBRM（Japanese Standards for Biological Raw Materials，生物原料日本標準）是日本 PMDA 對生物醫藥製造中生物原料的特定要求，由日本厚生勞動省（MHLW）發布。
blocks.en: JSBRM (Japanese Standards for Biological Raw Materials) are the specific requirements of Japan's PMDA for biological raw materials used in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, issued by the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW).

blocks.zh: JSBRM 的核心要求包括：
blocks.en: The core requirements of JSBRM include:

blocks.zh: 對所有動物源性和人源性物料的完整文件記錄
blocks.en: Complete documentation for all animal-derived and human-derived materials

blocks.zh: 製造商必須建立並維護生物原料的「起源和製造史（History of Manufacture）」文件
blocks.en: Manufacturers must establish and maintain documentation of the "origin and history of manufacture" of biological raw materials

blocks.zh: 比 EMA 或 FDA 更嚴格的 TSE 風險評估要求
blocks.en: TSE risk assessment requirements stricter than those of the EMA or FDA

blocks.zh: 對於計劃進入日本市場的 ATMP CDMO，JSBRM 合規往往是最耗時的前期準備工作，應在物料採購策略制定階段就納入考量，而非等到日本申請時才補救。
blocks.en: For ATMP CDMOs planning to enter the Japanese market, JSBRM compliance is often the most time-consuming up-front preparation work. It should be built into the materials sourcing strategy from the start, rather than remedied only when the Japanese application is filed.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — RUO 物料的合規邊界
blocks.en: Key Point: The Compliance Boundary of RUO Materials

blocks.zh: RUO（Research Use Only，僅供研究用）是 ATMP 物料管理中最常見的合規挑戰。RUO 等級物料的主要問題：
blocks.en: RUO (Research Use Only) is the most common compliance challenge in ATMP materials management. The main problems with RUO-grade materials are:

blocks.zh: 生產環境不受 GMP 監管：供應商可能無 GMP 廠房認證
blocks.en: Production environment not under GMP oversight: the supplier may have no GMP facility certification

blocks.zh: 規格標準較鬆散：CoA 可能缺少 GMP 製造所需的部分關鍵測試項目
blocks.en: Looser specifications: the CoA may lack some critical tests required for GMP manufacturing

blocks.zh: 批間差異較大：缺乏嚴格的製程控制
blocks.en: Greater lot-to-lot variability: lack of strict process control

blocks.zh: 法規申請風險：FDA 和 EMA 在商業申請中對 RUO 物料的接受度極低
blocks.en: Regulatory filing risk: the FDA and EMA have very low acceptance of RUO materials in commercial applications

blocks.zh: 然而，在 ATMP 早期臨床開發中，許多關鍵物料（如特定細胞因子、稀有生長因子）目前只有 RUO 等級可購。PtC-13 後續章節提供了在不得不使用 RUO 物料時的風險緩解策略（如強化進料測試、供應商稽核）。
blocks.en: However, in early clinical development of ATMPs, many critical materials (such as specific cytokines and rare growth factors) are currently available only as RUO grade. Later sections of PtC-13 provide risk mitigation strategies for when RUO materials cannot be avoided (such as enhanced incoming testing and supplier audits).

blocks.zh: JSBRM 是日本特有的生物原料標準。若您的公司正在為一個 CAR-T 產品準備日本 PMDA 的臨床申請，請列出至少三項需要比 FDA IND 額外準備的物料文件。
blocks.en: JSBRM is a uniquely Japanese standard for biological raw materials. If your company is preparing a clinical filing with Japan's PMDA for a CAR-T product, list at least three material documents that must be prepared in addition to those for an FDA IND.

blocks.zh: iPSC（誘導多能幹細胞）作為下一代異體細胞治療的平台技術，其細胞庫（Cell Bank）本身是否屬於 PtC-13 定義的「起始物料（Starting Materials）」？從初級/次級/三級分類的角度，iPSC 細胞庫應如何分類？
blocks.en: As a platform technology for next-generation allogeneic cell therapy, does the iPSC cell bank itself count as a "starting material" as defined in PtC-13? From the perspective of the primary/secondary/tertiary classification, how should an iPSC cell bank be classified?

blocks.zh: 某 CAR-T 製程使用了含有人血小板溶解物（human Platelet Lysate, hPL）作為培養基添加物，hPL 是什麼分類的物料？需要哪些特別的病毒安全性文件？
blocks.en: A CAR-T process uses human platelet lysate (hPL) as a medium supplement. What classification of material is hPL, and what special viral safety documentation is required?

blocks.zh: 決策優先級強化 Decision Hierarchy
blocks.en: Decision Hierarchy

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — ATMP 物料管理的決策優先級
blocks.en: Key Point: The Decision Hierarchy for ATMP Materials Management

blocks.zh: 在 ATMP 物料選擇和供應商決策中，當多個考量相互衝突時，請遵循以下優先級：
blocks.en: When considerations conflict in ATMP material selection and supplier decisions, follow this order of priority:

blocks.zh:
1. 無菌保證 & 患者安全
Sterility Assurance / Patient Safety
blocks.en:
1. Sterility Assurance & Patient Safety
Sterility Assurance / Patient Safety

blocks.zh:
2. 產品關鍵品質屬性
Product CQAs (Efficacy, Identity, Purity)
blocks.en:
2. Product Critical Quality Attributes
Product CQAs (Efficacy, Identity, Purity)

blocks.zh:
3. 商業與法規可行性
Business Needs & Regulatory Strategy
blocks.en:
3. Business and Regulatory Feasibility
Business Needs & Regulatory Strategy

blocks.zh: 實務含義：若一個物料供應商報價最低，且交期最短，但無法提供完整的 TSE 風險評估文件（威脅患者安全），則應拒絕使用，無論商業壓力多大。在 ATMP 領域，無替代治療的患者通常正在承受生命威脅——這使得物料管理決策的道德重量遠超傳統藥品。
blocks.en: Practical implication: if a material supplier offers the lowest price and the shortest lead time but cannot provide complete TSE risk assessment documentation (a threat to patient safety), the material should be rejected, however great the commercial pressure. In the ATMP field, patients with no alternative treatment are often facing life-threatening conditions, which gives materials management decisions a moral weight far beyond that of conventional drugs.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — ATMP 物料如同「最後防線的磚塊」
blocks.en: Analogy: ATMP Materials as the "Bricks of the Last Line of Defense"

blocks.zh: 傳統口服藥生產，原料的微小品質偏差或許可以被製程後續步驟（如再結晶、滅菌）吸收。但 ATMP 製造更像是一棟沒有任何補救機會的建築——如果最底層的磚塊（原物料）本身就帶有裂縫（如 TSE 污染、批間差異導致細胞活性下降），整棟建築（最終療效和安全性）都無法挽救。
blocks.en: In conventional oral drug manufacturing, small quality deviations in raw materials may be absorbed by later process steps (such as recrystallization and sterilization). ATMP manufacturing is more like a building with no chance of repair: if the bricks at the very bottom (raw materials) are already cracked (for example, TSE contamination, or lot-to-lot variability that lowers cell viability), the whole building (final efficacy and safety) cannot be saved.

blocks.zh: 這正是 PtC-13 整份文件的核心出發點：原物料管理，不是 ATMP 製造的最後一道程序，而是第一道且最關鍵的防線。
blocks.en: This is the starting point of the entire PtC-13 document: raw materials management is not the last step of ATMP manufacturing but the first and most critical line of defense.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 複雜性根源：ATMP 原物料面臨的挑戰遠超傳統藥品——動物/人源衍生、無藥典標準、RUO 等級、單一供應商、供應商 GMP 成熟度不足、全球法規不統一，六大因素疊加形成獨特的風險環境。
blocks.en: Sources of complexity: the challenges facing ATMP raw materials go far beyond those of conventional drugs. Animal/human derivation, lack of pharmacopoeial standards, RUO grade, single sourcing, insufficient supplier GMP maturity and non-harmonized global regulations combine into six overlapping factors that create a unique risk environment.

blocks.zh: 適用範圍：PtC-13 涵蓋所有與製程流接觸的物料（起始物料、輔助物料、賦形劑、耗材、容器密封系統），適用於臨床與商業製造兩個階段，涵蓋 mRNA、AAV 基因治療、細胞治療及組織工程產品。
blocks.en: Scope: PtC-13 covers all materials that contact the process stream (starting materials, ancillary materials, excipients, consumables, container-closure systems), applies to both clinical and commercial manufacturing, and covers mRNA, AAV gene therapy, cell therapy and tissue-engineered products.

blocks.zh: 三層分類系統：初級（Primary）= 直接來自動物/人體；次級（Secondary）= 製程中使用動物/人源物料；三級（Tertiary）= 最終不含動物/人源成分但製程使用次級物料。此分類直接對應 TSE 風險評估的深度要求。
blocks.en: Three-tier classification system: Primary = taken directly from animals/the human body; Secondary = animal/human-derived materials used in the process; Tertiary = the final material contains no animal/human-derived components but the process used secondary materials. This classification maps directly to the depth of TSE risk assessment required.

blocks.zh: CJD / TSE / BSE：這三者構成動物源性物料最嚴重的生物安全威脅，CoO（原產地證書）是評估 TSE 風險的關鍵文件，在 FDA、EMA、PMDA 法規申請中均不可或缺。
blocks.en: CJD / TSE / BSE: these three constitute the most serious biosafety threat from animal-derived materials. The CoO (Certificate of Origin) is the key document for assessing TSE risk and is indispensable in FDA, EMA and PMDA filings.

blocks.zh: 法規景觀：FDA / EMA / PMDA / PIC/S 對 ATMP 物料的要求存在顯著差異，JSBRM 是進入日本市場的特殊門檻，多地區 CDMO 須提前為差異性法規文件做準備。
blocks.en: Regulatory landscape: requirements for ATMP materials differ significantly among the FDA, EMA, PMDA and PIC/S. JSBRM is a special hurdle for entering the Japanese market, and multi-region CDMOs must prepare region-specific regulatory documents in advance.

blocks.zh: 決策優先級：患者安全（TSE 風險、無菌保證）永遠優先於商業考量，物料管理是 ATMP 製造的第一道防線，而非最後程序。
blocks.en: Decision hierarchy: patient safety (TSE risk, sterility assurance) always takes priority over commercial considerations, and materials management is the first line of defense in ATMP manufacturing, not the last step.
